portfolio_construction_rule: At least five independently eligible candidates, no more than 5% of portfolio per REIT and 10% per manager. No use of a one-quarter annualization, forecast distribution or historical rate as a current eligibility substitute.
warnings: Public REITs are closed-end exchange-traded funds; cash distributions may reduce NAV.
The candidate pool has more than one rental-housing exposure and must be screened for sector correlation before activation.
Historical cash-flow distribution rate is not total return and cannot support a future 5% return claim.
